name: Alejandro Gallardo
bio:
Alejandro Gallardo is a highly skilled tattoo artist specializing in minimalist and floral designs, whose attention to detail and artistic finesse are evident in every piece they create. Located in the heart of Miami, Alejandro welcomes both appointments and walk-ins at their clean and professional studio, ensuring every client leaves with a beautiful work of art and a positive tattooing experience. Whether it's your first tattoo or an addition to your collection, Alejandro's expertise will bring your vision to life with precision and care.
